steps.headline: One row for help, instead of two?
steps.changed: The "Development" row is gone from the Settings list; everything it held now lives in "Help & feedback" (its description now reads "Tour, tips, feedback, contributing").
steps.notice: The Settings list gets one row shorter. Nothing is lost — see the next two steps.

steps.headline: Help & feedback in three labelled groups — better?
steps.changed: "Getting started" (the tour, tips), "Questions and feedback" (Reddit, report a bug, known issues, the roadmap), "Help build YouCoded" (contribute, beta builds). "Known issues and planned features" becomes two rows, Known issues and Roadmap, like Development had.
steps.notice: The small "YouCoded 1.3.0" line at the bottom is gone — About shows the version, and a loose line broke the nothing-bare rule. The popup is a little wider (the standard Settings width) to fit the groups.

steps.headline: Development's rows, now at the bottom of Help — right place?
steps.changed: Left: today's separate Development popup. Right: the same rows inside Help & feedback. Report a bug, Known issues and Roadmap appear once instead of twice; Contribute and Get beta builds sit under "Help build YouCoded".
steps.notice: The Development popup's intro sentence ("Help make YouCoded better…") is dropped; the group label says it.
